sections.title: Cheat sheet: the whole chapter in one breath

board_events.text: Six sub-topics, one thread
The fence: the square bracket separates the bonded coordination sphere from the ionisable counter ions
Isomerism splits in two: structural means different bonds $-$ ionisation, solvate, linkage, coordination; stereo means same bonds, different space $-$ geometrical and optical.
Bonding dictionary: inner orbital equals low spin, outer orbital equals high spin; a big gap absorbs the blue end; observed colour is the complement of the absorbed light.
Carbonyls: give and take both ways $-$ sigma forward, pi back $-$ is synergic; back$-$donation weakens the carbon$-$oxygen bond; first$-$row carbonyls aim for thirty six.
Stability: logs add while constants multiply; claws beat crowds, so a chelate outranks more monodentate ligands; far is not fast, so stable is not the same as inert.
Applications: every one is control of a metal through a stable complex $-$ magnesium leaf, iron blood, cobalt vitamin, rhodium catalyst; cis works, trans shirks.
Memory aids: count atoms not arms; ambi means both ends; plane of symmetry kills optical activity; cyanide to catch, thiosulphate to fix
If you keep just one thread from the whole chapter, keep this: a ligand donates a lone pair to a metal, and everything else $-$ shape, colour, magnetism, stability, use $-$ follows from that.

segments.text: Finally, the cheat sheet: six sub-topics pulled onto one thread.
First, the fence: the square bracket separates the bonded coordination sphere from the ionisable counter ions.
Isomerism splits in two: structural means different bonds, ionisation, solvate, linkage and coordination; stereo means the same bonds but different space, geometrical and optical.
The bonding dictionary: inner orbital equals low spin, outer orbital equals high spin; a big gap absorbs the blue end; and the observed colour is the complement of the absorbed light.
Carbonyls: give and take both ways, sigma forward and pi back, is synergic; back donation weakens the carbon oxygen bond; and first row carbonyls aim for thirty six.
Stability: logs add while constants multiply; claws beat crowds, so a chelate outranks more monodentate ligands; and far is not fast, so stable is not the same as inert.
Applications: every one is control of a metal through a stable complex, magnesium leaf, iron blood, cobalt vitamin, rhodium catalyst, and cis works while trans shirks.
Keep the memory aids handy: count atoms not arms, ambi means both ends, a plane of symmetry kills optical activity, and cyanide to catch, thiosulphate to fix.
And if you keep just one thread from the whole chapter, keep this: a ligand donates a lone pair to a metal, and everything else, shape, colour, magnetism, stability and use, follows from that.
आख़िर में, cheat sheet: छह sub-topics एक thread पर।
पहला, fence: square bracket bonded coordination sphere को ionisable counter ions से अलग करता है।
Isomerism दो में बँटती है: structural मतलब अलग bonds, ionisation, solvate, linkage और coordination; stereo मतलब same bonds पर अलग space, geometrical और optical.
bonding dictionary: inner orbital बराबर low spin, outer orbital बराबर high spin; बड़ा gap blue end absorb करता है; और observed colour absorbed light का complement होता है।
Carbonyls: दोनों तरफ़ give and take, sigma forward और pi back, synergic है; back donation carbon oxygen bond weaken करती है; और first row carbonyls thirty six aim करते हैं।
Stability: logs जुड़ते हैं जबकि constants गुणा होते हैं; claws beat crowds, तो एक chelate ज़्यादा monodentate ligands को हराता है; और far is not fast, तो stable, inert जैसा नहीं है।
Applications: हर एक एक stable complex के ज़रिए metal का control है, magnesium leaf, iron blood, cobalt vitamin, rhodium catalyst, और cis works जबकि trans shirks.
memory aids हाथ में रखो: count atoms not arms, ambi means both ends, plane of symmetry optical activity को मार देता है, और cyanide to catch, thiosulphate to fix.
और अगर पूरे chapter से सिर्फ़ एक thread रखना हो, तो ये रखो: एक ligand एक metal को lone pair donate करता है, और बाक़ी सब कुछ, shape, colour, magnetism, stability और use, उसी से follow होता है।
